relevance_note: The paper describes three children with HA20 due to TNFAIP3 variants, with sex, ages, symptoms and treatment per patient ('haploinsufficiency of A20 (HA20; three cases)').
method_note: Read the paper myself (front matter, abstract, Methods, Results, Tables 1-3, figure legends and the converted Supplementary material); no script transcribed anything. Scope: the only in-scope people are the three probands with a TNFAIP3 variant (P6, P7, P8) plus the two fathers named in Table 1 as the source of their variant ('TNFAIP3 (father)'), which I treated as relatives described in relation to an in-scope person; the other SAID+ probands (RELA x5, GATA2 x1, trisomy 8 x1) and the 24 ped-BD patients get no rows (cohort_size_as_stated = 34). No variant description is printed anywhere - the variants are only in Figure 1 ('Pedigrees and details of the variants'), which is not converted - so every variant_original_string is 'not reported'. Notes: (1) Table 1 labels P3 as 'P3 (P2's daughter)'; P3 is RELA and out of scope. (2) Table 3 and Supplementary Table 1 give group values only; per D-24 the '0' cells in the SAID+ column ('Neurological manifestations (n) | 0', 'Vascular signs (n) | 0', 'Positive pathergy test (n) | 0') are counts without names and exclude nobody, so no checklist item rests on them. (3) Contradiction: Table 3 prints 'Vascular signs (n) | 0' for SAID+ while the Figure 3 legend reports for proband 6 histology 'consistent with vasculitis'; the zero count is not evidence about a person, so P6's vasculitis is kept as observed. (4) Inheritance for P6 and P8 comes from the Table 1 cell 'TNFAIP3 (father)'; P7 is called de novo in Table 1 and in the Results, but the paper never describes parental testing, so the authors' statement is followed and parental_testing_statement is left 'not reported'. (5) Variant type, zygosity, pathogenicity and ACMG criteria are 'not reported' because the only statements are cohort-level or list several values for a group ('pathogenic or likely pathogenic germline variants in RELA, TNFAIP3 (encoding A20), and GATA2'; 'All of the variants (except for trisomy 8) are predicted to result in frameshift or truncation'), which D-29 does not allow assigning to one person. (6) Table 1 prints 'fever' for P6 and P7 while the checklist item is 'recurrent fever'; no functional studies were performed ('we did not pursue functional studies for the SAID-associated variants'). (7) No cell in the converted tables was a stacked ' / ' cell.
